notes: Fair puzzle: each decoy fails exactly one constraint, and the reviews say so clearly.

The dairy constraint is a nice twist: Roxy first proposes condensed-milk iced coffee, then Brooke reminds her about the 'milkshake incident'. Easy to catch because Roxy spells it out right after ('nothing with milk, cream or butter'), so it isn't really hidden.
No explicit budget line in the chat. All five venues are $, so it doesn't matter here, but a player may wonder whether budget was meant to be a constraint.
Little Lotus's second review names both the peanut and dairy safety outright, which makes the answer fairly obvious once the constraints are listed.
Jade Lantern's review heads off the 'just skip the iced coffee' workaround by saying dairy runs through the mains. Good, it closes that loophole.
